    - text: PHASE 1 · CONTINUED FRACTIONS
    - heading "Euclidean Algorithm Link" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Euclidean division quotients are exactly the partial quotients of a rational continued fraction.
    - text: "#2003 · 15 min · Advanced · Continued Fractions"
    - navigation "Lesson sections":
      - button "Sync"
      - button "Euclid"
      - button "Continued Fraction"
      - button "Reverse"
      - button "Practice"
    - text: a =
    - spinbutton "Euclidean numerator a": "43"
    - text: b =
    - spinbutton "Euclidean denominator b": "19"
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - article:
      - heading "Euclidean Algorithm" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Repeated division with remainder
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Step Division Quotient Remainder":
            - columnheader "Step"
            - columnheader "Division"
            - columnheader "Quotient"
            - columnheader "Remainder"
        - rowgroup:
          - 'row "Select Euclidean step 1 Quotient at step 1: 2 5"':
            - cell "Select Euclidean step 1":
              - button "Select Euclidean step 1" [pressed]: "1"
            - cell:
              - math: 43 = 2 × 19 + 5
            - 'cell "Quotient at step 1: 2"':
              - 'button "Quotient at step 1: 2"': "2"
            - cell "5"
          - 'row "Select Euclidean step 2 Quotient at step 2: 3 4"':
            - cell "Select Euclidean step 2":
              - button "Select Euclidean step 2": "2"
            - cell:
              - math: 19 = 3 × 5 + 4
            - 'cell "Quotient at step 2: 3"':
              - 'button "Quotient at step 2: 3"': "3"
            - cell "4"
          - 'row "Select Euclidean step 3 Quotient at step 3: 1 1"':
            - cell "Select Euclidean step 3":
              - button "Select Euclidean step 3": "3"
            - cell:
              - math: 5 = 1 × 4 + 1
            - 'cell "Quotient at step 3: 1"':
              - 'button "Quotient at step 3: 1"': "1"
            - cell "1"
          - 'row "Select Euclidean step 4 Quotient at step 4: 4 0"':
            - cell "Select Euclidean step 4":
              - button "Select Euclidean step 4": "4"
            - cell:
              - math: 4 = 4 × 1 + 0
            - 'cell "Quotient at step 4: 4"':
              - 'button "Quotient at step 4: 4"': "4"
            - cell "0"
      - paragraph: "Stop: remainder is 0"
      - strong: gcd(43, 19) = 1
      - paragraph: The last nonzero remainder is the gcd.
    - article:
      - button "Step":
        - img
        - text: Step
      - button "Auto":
        - img
        - text: Auto
      - button "Reverse":
        - img
        - text: Reverse
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "k Expression Operation Value":
            - columnheader "k"
            - columnheader "Expression"
            - columnheader "Operation"
            - columnheader "Value"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Select reciprocal step 0 2":
            - cell "Select reciprocal step 0":
              - button "Select reciprocal step 0" [pressed]: "0"
            - cell:
              - math: 43 19
            - cell:
              - math: a 0 = ⌊ 43 19 ⌋
            - cell "2"
          - row "Select reciprocal step 1 3":
            - cell "Select reciprocal step 1":
              - button "Select reciprocal step 1": "1"
            - cell:
              - math: 19 5
            - cell:
              - math: x 1 = 1 43 19 − 2
            - cell "3"
          - row "Select reciprocal step 2 1":
            - cell "Select reciprocal step 2":
              - button "Select reciprocal step 2": "2"
            - cell:
              - math: 5 4
            - cell:
              - math: x 2 = 1 19 5 − 3
            - cell "1"
          - row "Select reciprocal step 3 4":
            - cell "Select reciprocal step 3":
              - button "Select reciprocal step 3": "3"
            - cell:
              - math: 4 1
            - cell:
              - math: x 3 = 1 5 4 − 1
            - cell "4"
      - paragraph: "Remainder zero: the reciprocal is undefined. Stop here."
      - text: "[2; 3, 1, 4] ="
      - strong: 43/19
      - paragraph: "Step 1: quotient 2, remainder 5"
    - 'heading "Area model: visualizing the first two divisions" [level=2]'
    - text: Show remainder chain
    - switch "Show remainder chain" [checked]
    - article:
      - 'heading "Step 1: 43 = 2 × 19 + 5" [level=3]'
      - img "43 units partitioned into 2 blocks of 19 and remainder 5": 43 units 19 19 2 blocks of 19 remainder 5
    - article:
      - 'heading "Step 2: 19 = 3 × 5 + 4" [level=3]'
      - img "19 units partitioned into 3 blocks of 5 and remainder 4": 19 units 5 5 5 3 blocks of 5 remainder 4
    - article:
      - heading "Remainder chain" [level=3]
      - text: "43"
      - img
      - text: "19"
      - img
      - text: "5"
      - img
      - text: "4"
      - img
      - text: "1"
      - img
      - text: "0"
      - paragraph: The chain ends at 0.
      - paragraph: The last nonzero entry (1) is gcd(43, 19).
    - heading "Invariants (true at every step)" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "Division identity" [level=3]
      - math: A = q B + r
      - paragraph: with 0 ≤ r < B.
    - article:
      - heading "Value preserved" [level=3]
      - math: A B = q + r B
      - paragraph: For r > 0, r/B = 1/(B/r).
    - article:
      - heading "Termination" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Nonnegative integer remainders strictly decrease until a remainder is 0.
    - complementary:
      - heading "Common misconception" [level=3]:
        - img
        - text: Common misconception
      - paragraph: Remainders are NOT the partial quotients.
      - paragraph: Only the quotients form the continued fraction.
    - heading "Try other examples" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "Default (coprime)" [level=3]
      - strong: 43/19
      - paragraph: "Euclid steps: 4"
      - text: 2 3 1 4
      - paragraph: "CF: [2; 3, 1, 4]"
      - paragraph: gcd(43, 19) = 1
      - button "Load example":
        - img
        - text: Load example
    - article:
      - heading "Common factor example" [level=3]
      - strong: 84/30
      - paragraph: "Euclid steps: 3"
      - text: 2 1 4
      - paragraph: "CF: [2; 1, 4]"
      - paragraph: gcd(84, 30) = 6
      - button "Load example":
        - img
        - text: Load example
    - article:
      - heading "Fibonacci example" [level=3]
      - strong: 34/21
      - paragraph: "Euclid steps: 7"
      - text: 1 1 1 1 1 1 2
      - paragraph: "CF: [1; 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2]"
      - paragraph: gcd(34, 21) = 1
      - button "Load example":
        - img
        - text: Load example
    - complementary:
      - heading "Reverse Build (from CF)" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Enter partial quotients:"
      - text: a
      - subscript: "0"
      - spinbutton "Reverse partial quotient 0": "2"
      - text: a
      - subscript: "1"
      - spinbutton "Reverse partial quotient 1": "3"
      - text: a
      - subscript: "2"
      - spinbutton "Reverse partial quotient 2": "1"
      - text: a
      - subscript: "3"
      - spinbutton "Reverse partial quotient 3": "4"
      - button "Remove partial quotient":
        - img
      - button "Add partial quotient":
        - img
      - paragraph: "Build: [2; 3, 1, 4]"
      - paragraph: a/b = 43/19
      - button "Build & Show Euclid":
        - text: Build & Show Euclid
        - img

    - complementary:
      - heading "Pro Tip" [level=3]:
        - img
        - text: Pro Tip
      - paragraph: Each division creates exactly one partial quotient.
      - paragraph: The number of divisions, including the final zero-remainder division, equals the number of partial quotients.
